ticket.title: WebESS - Time and Attendance - Cancelled Leave Is Still Displayed as Approved Leave

scope: Bug fix: a leave date whose latest Leave Request Detail transaction has Amount=0 (cancelled) must not show as Approved Leave in Time and Attendance. Run is read-only; it can only verify with an account/date that actually has a cancelled leave.

cases.title: Cancelled leave date (latest transaction Amount=0) is not shown as Approved Leave
cases.preconditions: Employee with an original leave (Amount=1, Completed) and a later cancellation (Amount=0, Completed) on the same date

steps.expected: Attendance page loads for the signed-in employee
steps.actual: Attendance page loaded: 'Attendance > My attendance', week view, hours summary shown

steps.action: Go to week 28 Sep - 4 Oct and inspect the date with cancelled leave
steps.expected: Date is not shown as Approved Leave
steps.actual: Week '28 Sept - 4 Oct' shows 'Mon 28/09 · No records' … 'Sun 04/10 · No records'. This profile has no leave data for the date, so the cancelled-leave scenario cannot be exercised; needs the account with the cancelled leave (Long Do, 28/09/2026) or a seeded cancel.

cases.title: Date with still-effective approved leave shows as Approved Leave (regression)
cases.preconditions: Employee with an effective approved leave

steps.action: Open Attendance on a week containing effective approved leave
steps.actual: No effective approved leave exists for this profile in the weeks viewed (all 'No records'); needs an account with an approved leave.

observations: Signed-in ESS profile is Amol R Bhangale (staff 20065716), not the account of the tester named in the ticket comments (Long Do, week 28/09-04/10).
